name: Seishinteki Gaishou ~Trauma~
source:
You are Sakuba Kenichi, a private tutor for a high school student named Souki, who you find to be quiet and impolite. As her mother explains, her behavior is a result of an accident that occurred three years ago. At that time a criminal killed her father and wounded Souki. Her grades started to drop tremendously due to locking up in herself. Hopefully, you can break the ice and heal her wound.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=180&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演作场健一，一名高中生宗希的私人家教。你发现宗希沉默寡言、态度无礼。她的母亲解释说，这种行为源于三年前发生的一场事故。当时，一名罪犯杀死了她的父亲，并使宗希受伤。由于把自己封闭起来，她的成绩开始大幅下滑。希望你能打破她的心防，治愈她的伤口。

[译自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=180&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
